description: Mixed: good branding and empathy, resolves issue, but skips identity verification, paraphrasing, and probing.
transcript:
[00:00] Client: Hey, my broadband keeps dropping every few minutes.
[00:05] Agent: Thank you for calling S-NET Communications, my name is Sam. I'm sorry about the drops, let's get that sorted.
[00:12] Client: Thanks. It's really annoying during meetings.
[00:16] Agent: I completely understand. Let me push a fresh configuration to your router now.
[00:23] Agent: Okay, I've reset the connection profile on our end. Can you check if it's stable now?
[00:45] Client: It looks stable so far, yeah.
[00:49] Agent: Great. That should hold. If it drops again in the next day, give us a call back.
[00:56] Client: Will do, thanks Sam.
[01:00] Agent: No problem. Thank you for Choosing S-NET and have a good one.
